plan.major: Communication - Messaging and Human Interaction Emphasis
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-12 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Communication - Messaging and Human Interaction Emphasis program page and its linked official degree map workbook, 'Communication Degree Maps (2026-2027)', 'Messaging & Human Interaction (Campus)' tab, last updated/reviewed August 7, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the BS: the catalog prints Total Credits, BA Degree: 120 and Total Credits, BS Degree: 120 as separate lines; the map totals exactly the BS 120 and expressly does not include the BA's 16 credits of one foreign language. The catalog's BS requirement is 12 credits of Math or Science courses (at least 3 credits MATH numbered 1000 or above, excluding MATH 1030 or MATH 1040, and at least 3 credits of Science courses numbered 1000 or above), and the catalog notes a portion of the BS requirement may be met by satisfying General Education requirements; the map does not label BS courses separately. The catalog's General Education block prints only Core Course Requirements (12+ credits) and Breadth Area Requirements (16+ credits) with 'See General Education for course options'; the map's GE rows are recorded as printed. The catalog's Free Electives section prints no fixed figure (the total is determined by the General Education courses taken, degree type, additional credits earned and prerequisite courses needed). Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (15 each) and the plan to the catalog's printed BS degree total of 120. The catalog's curriculum reconciles: Required Core Courses 9 + Required Courses 27 (15 + the Emphasis Required Courses block of 12) + Electives 9 = the printed Curriculum heading of 45 credits; all twelve named core/required courses appear on the map and the map's three major-elective slots total the Electives block's 9 credits. The map's Free Electives and Free Upper-division Electives rows total 50 credits; the catalog prints no free-elective total, so that figure is the map's as printed. DISCLOSED: the catalog's Program Information also states a grade of 'C-' or better is required in all Communication core courses (COMM 3100, COMM 4000, COMM 4890), although COMM 4890 appears on this page only as an Electives option, not in the Required Core or Required Courses. DISCLOSED catalog inconsistency, not reconciled: every Communication emphasis page's Program Information prints a Communication Composite paragraph (65 credits in Communication, including a Communication Core of 6 and Required Courses of 15 in each of two emphases, plus 29 elective credits) whose 6/15 figures match none of the emphasis pages' own Required Core / Required Courses headings; the Composite program itself publishes no program-specific degree map and was not collected. Program information printed in the catalog: a minimum GPA of 2.5 is required to enroll in the major, a grade of 'C-' or better is required in all courses required for the major and the emphasis, and a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.0.
